data.title: Explore Our Neighborhood Map
data.description: Join us on a fun journey to use the compass rose and explore all the exciting spots on our map!

challenges.instruction: Which way is Metropolitan Market Queen Anne from Queen Anne Library? Tap the compass.
Which way is Climate Pledge from Denny Park? Tap the compass.
Which way is Denny Park from Fire Station? Tap the compass.
Which way is Playground from Science Center? Tap the compass.
Which way is Kids Museum from Playground? Tap the compass.

places.name: Queen Anne Library
places.fullName: Queen Anne Branch - The Seattle Public Library
places.blurb: You can find picture books about friendly dragons and read them.

places.name: Metropolitan Market Queen Anne
places.blurb: This grocery store has a giant cookie counter with warm cookies.

places.name: Science Center
places.blurb: You can walk through a warm room filled with colorful butterflies.

places.name: Playground
places.blurb: You can climb up a giant tower and zoom down a tall slide.

places.name: Denny Park
places.blurb: You can play on the fun swings and run around on the grass.

places.name: Whole Foods
places.blurb: You can pick out a bright, shiny apple for a snack.

places.name: Fire Station
places.blurb: Real firefighters work here and drive huge red trucks with sirens.

places.name: Climate Pledge
places.blurb: This is where the hockey team plays games on slippery ice.

places.name: Kids Museum
places.blurb: You get to pretend to run a store and dress up in costumes.
